duties: You’ll partner closely with customer-care call centers and teams across network, engineering, operations, sales, marketing, finance, legal, regulatory, and corporate communications.

Lead transformation and product-retirement strategy: Define and communicate the wireline transformation strategy, roadmap, measurable outcomes, sunset milestones, dependencies, decision points, and readiness criteria for legacy products, platforms, technologies, services, and processes.

Plan customer migrations: Segment affected customers, establish migration strategies, and define paths to target end-state products or technologies while managing customer retention, service continuity, and escalation risks.

create business cases supporting product retirement, platform simplification, and customer migration.

Coordinate agent procedures, training, product-transition guidance, knowledge articles, frequently asked questions, call scripts, and job aids.

Coordinate communications and technical execution: Develop internal and customer-facing communication plans with customer care, marketing, sales, legal, regulatory, corporate communications, engineering, network, and other stakeholders.

Manage governance, risk, and performance: Lead cross-functional governance, resolve escalations, and manage risks involving billing, ordering, revenue, service continuity, operational readiness, customer migration, and escalation resolution.
Track and report migration progress, customer retention, contact volume, customer sentiment, cost savings, and decommissioning progress to senior leadership.
preferredSkills: along with experience creating customer communications
Help shape the future of wireline connectivity by making complex transitions easier for customers and the teams that support them.
You’ll have the opportunity to lead high-impact transformation programs

Design and build production-grade AI-enabled applications, backend services, and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Create agentic AI workflows using LangGraph or similar frameworks, including tool calling, routing, planning and execution, multi-step workflows, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

Implement automated testing, CI/CD, Docker-based deployment, and resilient distributed-system patterns including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
preferredSkills: Hands-on experience with LangGraph or comparable agent orchestration frameworks.
Experience designing multi-agent or multi-step agentic workflows.
Knowledge of event-driven architectures using Kafka
and vector databases in production environments.

duties: Lead end-to-end program execution for a complex Federal advanced wireless technology program, managing activities from planning and design through integration, testing, field demonstration, acceptance, and closeout.

Monitor program financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, supplier commitments, resources, and the cost and schedule impacts of proposed changes.

Provide executive and customer-facing program leadership and reporting, translating complex technical, schedule, financial, and operational information into clear status, recommendations, decisions, and actions.

duties: Design scalable patterns for agents to discover and securely invoke enterprise tools, APIs, services, data, and business processes.
Establish reference architectures for connecting AI platforms to enterprise systems such as Workday, ServiceNow, Databricks, Palantir, Power BI, and internal APIs.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine where they provide measurable enterprise value versus where traditional APIs, workflow automation, or deterministic solutions remain more appropriate.
Provide technical leadership for Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture and implementation.
Establish standards for MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, authentication, authorization, session management, observability, and lifecycle management.
Design AI-to-API connectivity while ensuring that agent actions honor the identity and authorization of the requesting user.

Mentor developers and architects building AI-enabled enterprise applications.

Establish appropriate approval patterns for high-impact agent actions, including human-in-the-loop and human-on-the-loop controls.
Ensure agent actions against systems such as Workday and ServiceNow remain traceable to the originating identity wherever business and regulatory requirements demand individual accountability.
Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, legal, risk, and platform teams to develop enterprise AI guardrails.
Provide architectural leadership across Workday Extend, Orchestrate, Studio, REST/SOAP APIs, business processes, security domains, and integration frameworks.
Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow AI capabilities, workflows, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, Transform Maps, Pro Code/custom development, and REST APIs.
Identify opportunities to augment employee and operational workflows through AI while maintaining platform security and audit controls.

duties: Manages accounts and partnerships with vendors by coordinating price negotiations for parts and services with Purchasing management;
reviewing contracts for purchasing and projects to ensure cost, scope, and terms of condition are acceptable with senior management;
Manages, protects, and improves Walmart assets by supporting the regional operations team during the home office budgeting development and approval process;
monitoring capital spending plans and expense budgets with maintenance operations;
developing annual overhaul and retrofit plans to return deteriorated and degraded facilities and equipment to acceptable operating condition;

Provides leadership to the regional operating team and developing and supporting ongoing initiatives by participating in annual meetings, travel, weekly calls, coordination of operational strategy, utilization of assets to support volume changes and forecasting, and establishment of standards;
developing and communicating key performance and financial indicators;
training managers on effective processes for preventative maintenance scheduling;
Provides support and direction for maintenance department operation in the logistics network which may include occasional travel by visiting distribution centers;

Ensures adherence to corporate policies in the area of distribution center (DC) maintenance management and compliance with regulatory policies and procedures (for example, OSHA, EPA, FSA, state and local authorities) by educating and training DC senior staff, maintenance associates, and regional operating teams on policies and procedures in the areas of corporate maintenance management, and regulatory compliance;

Develops new technology, processes, strategies and implements changes to improve throughput without impacting existing operations by managing facility and material handling projects to improve performance of the distribution network while limiting disruptions to operations and the distribution centers' (DC) ability to deliver freight to the stores;
developing relationships with Walmart members of cross-functional departments (for example, Construction, Insurance, Regional Operating teams) to ensure communication with DC Maintenance teams;

Develops skills and abilities of maintenance management and other maintenance associates to prepare them for promotional opportunities anticipated with the continued growth of the distribution center (DC) network by assessing needs and coordinating third party training activities in DCs designed to enhance maintenance department skills;
mentoring associates in leadership and project management;
developing and recruiting maintenance management candidates to support the DC network requirements;

Oversees maintenance department daily operations by monitoring and driving department performance related to maintaining warehouse equipment (e.g., material handling equipment, pneumatic systems, electrical systems, air compressors, ammonia refrigeration equipment, general building repairs);
